paite: Bel akun a, Nebo akihihniam a; amilimte gamsa leh gan tung ah ana omta ua; na thil vakpihte uh vanpuak abawl ua, gamsa bah a ding in van puakgik dia bawl ahi lel hi.
heading: Babulon pathiante
english: Bel bows down, Nebo stoops; their idols are on the animals, and on the livestock: the things that you carried about are made a load, a burden to the weary.

paite: Ana kihihniam un, ana kun chiat ua, van puakgik lah ahumbit thei ngal kei ua, amau mah sal a pi in a-om zawta uhi.
english: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves have gone into captivity.

paite: Jakob inkuanpihte leh, Israel inkuanpihte lak a khosuaksun tengteng aw, gil a kipan ka hon puak a, sul a pan a ka kithuahpihte aw, ka thu ngaikhia un.
english: “Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been borne from their birth, that have been carried from the womb;

paite: Tekkun a na om tanpha un leng amah ka hi ding a, na lu ua kelsam apou vek hun chiang in leng ka hon pom ding hi; ke'n ka bawl a, kei mahmah in ka po ding; ahi, ke'n ka pom ding a, ka humbit ding.
english: and even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs will I carry you. I have made, and I will bear; yes, I will carry, and will deliver.

paite: Kibang a seh ka hihna ding un kua toh na hon teh a, kua kimpih in na hon bawl a, kua toh ahia na hon teh ding?
english: “To whom will you liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?

paite: Zaip a kipan dangka-eng bungkhe zel dangka bukna a buk zelten, dangka-eng sekmi achial ua, ama'n huai pathian in abawl a, huchi in abokkhup ua, ahi, abe zel uhi.
english: Some pour out gold from the bag, and weigh silver in the balance. They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it a god. They fall down—yes, they worship.

paite: Aliangzang uah apua ua, apaipih ua, a-omna a kipan asuan nawn kei ding; ahi, min amah asam ding ua, himahleh adawng thei kei ding, amangbatna ua kipan ahunkhe thei kei ding hi.
english: They bear it on the shoulder, they carry it, and set it in its place, and it stands, from its place it shall not move: yes, one may cry to it, yet it can not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.

paite: Talek mite aw, huai theigige unla, kipasalsak unla, theikhe nawn un,
english: “Remember this, and show yourselves men; bring it again to mind, you transgressors.

paite: Nidang a thil masate theigige un; kei Pathian ka hi a, adang a-om kei; kei Pathian ka hi, kei bang a-om kei;
english: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me;

paite: Ke'n atawpna ding uh atung a kipan in ka gen a; pha ka sak adingsuak ding a, ka deihlam tengteng ka hih vek ding, ka chi hi;
english: declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done; saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure;

paite: Suahlam a kipan vasa duhgawl, khopi gamlapi a pan in ka miseh ka sam ding a; ahi, ka genta, ka tangtungsak ding; ka na tumta, ka hih ding.
english: calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country; yes, I have spoken, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed, I will also do it.

paite: Lungsim ki-uangsak, diktatna toh kigamlate aw, ka thu ngaikhia un;
english: Listen to me, you stout-hearted, who are far from righteousness:

paite: Ka diktatna ka hon tawi nai a, gamla ah a-om kei ding, ka hotdamna in leng sawt ahal kei ding; huchi in ka thupina Israelte a ding in hotdamna Zion ah ka koih ding.
english: I bring near my righteousness, it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not wait; and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.
